scripts.test:functional:characters: npm run test:functional:retrieval && npm run test:functional:generation && npm run test:functional:role && npm run test:functional:multiturn && npm run test:functional:robustness && npm run test:functional:ux
scripts.test:functional:retrieval: sh -c 'set -e; for d in testing/inputs/characters/*; do [ -d "$d" ] || continue; character=$(basename "$d"); echo "[functional:retrieval] running for $character"; tsx src/scripts/eval-character-retrieval.ts --character "$character"; done'
scripts.test:functional:generation: tsx src/scripts/eval-darwin-generation.ts && tsx src/scripts/eval-darwin-generation.ts --mode debate && tsx src/scripts/eval-darwin-generation.ts --mode call
scripts.test:functional:multiturn: tsx src/scripts/eval-darwin-multiturn.ts && tsx src/scripts/eval-darwin-multiturn.ts --mode debate && tsx src/scripts/eval-darwin-multiturn.ts --mode call
scripts.test:functional:robustness: tsx src/scripts/eval-darwin-robustness.ts && tsx src/scripts/eval-darwin-robustness.ts --mode debate && tsx src/scripts/eval-darwin-robustness.ts --mode call
scripts.test:functional:ux: tsx src/scripts/eval-darwin-ux.ts && tsx src/scripts/eval-darwin-ux.ts --mode debate && tsx src/scripts/eval-darwin-ux.ts --mode call
scripts.test:all: npm run test:integration && npm run test:functional
